race.comment: BARKING MAD (3) opened this prep with a couple of convincing wins in Victoria then stuck on well for a dead-heat second at Rosehill over 1500m last start. Nicely placed back in midweek company with just an extra 1.5kgs today. Hard to go past with J Mac to steer. ANTHRACITE (2) looks the danger after an eye-catching return last time out over 1300m at the Kensington track. Didn't have the best of luck in the early stages so his effort to get home hard was full of merit. Ideally placed out this trip with that run under the belt. THREE ARROWS (9) is back in form at the right time. Raced on the pace and refused to lie down under 60.5kgs at Illawarra Grange last start, beaten narrowly at the end of 1400m. On trial at the trip but should cope. FORECASTER (5) led and gave a kick when challenged but found one better over this distance at the Kensington track last time. Sure to run another bold race. Last start Forbes Cup winner VORACIOUS (1) is not out of contention at odds.
